Inductive vtp: senv -> qual -> qual -> tm -> ty -> qual -> Prop :=
| vtp_tabs: forall Σ ϰ φ t T1 T2 T3 T4 d1 d2 d3 d4 df1 df2,
  closed_tm 2 0 (‖Σ‖) t ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) (TAll d3 d4 T3 T4) ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
  has_type [(bind_ty, false, T1, d1); (bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), df1)] (df1 ⊔ $!0 ⊔ $!1) Σ
           (t <~²ᵗ ([] : tenv)) (T2 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d2 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv)) ->
  stp [] Σ T3 d3 T1 d1 ->
  qstp [] Σ df1 df2 ->
  stp [(bind_ty, false, T3, d3); (bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), {♦})] Σ
      (T2 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d2 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv))
      (T4 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d4 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv)) ->
  d1 ⊑↑ df1 ⊔ {♦} ->
  ♦∉ df1 ->
  kill_sep ϰ df2 ->
  kill_sep (local_locs t) df2 ->
  vtp Σ ϰ φ (ttabs t) (TAll d3 d4 T3 T4) df2

| vtp_base: forall Σ ϰ φ d,
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
  kill_sep ϰ d ->
  vtp Σ ϰ φ tunit TUnit d

| vtp_loc:  forall Σ ϰ φ l o T U q1 q2 d,
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q1↑ ->
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q2↑ ->
  l ∈ₗ φ ->
  sindexr l o Σ = Some (T,q1) ->
  stp [] Σ T ∅ U ∅ ->
  stp [] Σ U ∅ T ∅ ->
  qstp [] Σ (&!l) d ->
  ♦∉ q1 ->
  qstp [] Σ q1 q2 ->
  qstp [] Σ q2 q1 ->
  kill_sep ϰ d ->
  vtp Σ ϰ φ &(l, o) (TRef q2 U) d

| vtp_abs: forall Σ ϰ φ T1 d1 T2 d2 T3 d3 T4 d4 df1 df2 t,
  closed_tm 2 0 (‖Σ‖) t ->
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) df2↑ ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) (TFun d3 d4 T3 T4) ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
  has_type [(bind_tm, false,T1,d1) ; (bind_tm, true, (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2), df1)]
            (df1 ⊔ $!0 ⊔ $!1) Σ (t <~²ᵗ ([] : tenv)) (T2 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d2 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv)) ->
  stp [] Σ T3 d3 T1 d1 ->
  qstp [] Σ df1 df2 ->
  stp [(bind_tm, false,T3, d3) ; (bind_tm, true, (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2), {♦})] Σ
      (T2 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d2 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv))
      (T4 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d4 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv)) ->
  d1 ⊑↑ df1 ⊔ {♦} ->
  ♦∉ df1 ->
  kill_sep ϰ df2 ->
  kill_sep (local_locs t) df2 ->
  vtp Σ ϰ φ (tabs t) (TFun d3 d4 T3 T4) df2

| vtp_top: forall Σ ϰ φ t T d,
   vtp Σ ϰ φ t T d ->
  vtp Σ ϰ φ t TTop d
.

Definition not_free (v : id) (T : ty): Prop := [[ v ~> TUnit ~ ∅ ]]ᵀ T = T.

Fixpoint local_locs (t: tm) : qual :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t  => local_locs t
  | ttapp t  => local_locs t
  | tabs  t  => local_locs t
  | tapp t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tref  t  => local_locs t
  | trefat t1 t2 => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | tderef t  => local_locs t
  | tassign t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithr t1 t2  => (local_locs t1) ⊔ (local_locs t2)
  | twithc l t => &!l ⊔ (local_locs t)
  | _ => ∅
  end.

    kill_sep (local_locs t) df ->
    has_type ((bind_ty, false, T1, d1)  :: (bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), df) :: Γ)
             (df ⊔ ($!‖Γ‖) ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2 <~²ᵀ Γ) (d2 <~²ᵈ Γ) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttabs t) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) df

| t_tapp: forall Γ φ Σ t T1 T2 d1 d2 df,

    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T1 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d1↑ ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    d1 ⊑↑ φ ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttapp t) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

    d1 ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (♦∈ d1 -> not_free 1 T2) ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) (d2) ->

    has_type Γ φ Σ (ttapp t) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ tunit TUnit ∅

    indexr x Γ = Some ((bind_tm, b,T,d)) ->
    $!x ⊑↑ φ ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    closed_ty   0 x (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 x (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ $x T $!x

    closed_tm   2 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) t ->
    closed_ty   0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    d1 ⊑↑ df ⊔ {♦} ->
    df ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t) df ->
    has_type ((bind_tm, false, T1, d1) :: (bind_tm, true, (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2), df) :: Γ)
             (df ⊔ ($!‖Γ‖) ⊔ $!(S (‖Γ‖))) Σ (t <~²ᵗ Γ) (T2 <~²ᵀ Γ) (d2 <~²ᵈ Γ) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tabs t) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df

| t_app : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (df) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1 ⊔ local_locs t2) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tapp t1 t2) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_app_fresh : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 d1 t2 d2 df T1 T2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TFun (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ d1) d2 T1 T2) df ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T1 d1 ->
    (♦∈ d1 -> not_free 1 T2) ->
    not_free 0 T2 ->
    (d2 <~ᵈ ∅ ; ∅) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df) ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (df) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1 ⊔ local_locs t2) (d2) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) ((q_trans_tenv Γ d1) ⋒ (q_trans_tenv Γ df)) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tapp t1 t2) (T2 <~ᵀ TUnit ~ ∅ ; T1 ~ d1) (d2 <~ᵈ df ; d1)

| t_loc : forall Γ φ Σ l o T q,
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) φ↑ ->
    sindexr l o Σ = Some (T,q) ->
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    &!l ⊑↑ φ ->
    ♦∉ q ->

    has_type Γ φ Σ &(l,o) (TRef q T) (&!l)

| t_ref: forall Γ φ Σ T t d1,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t T d1 ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tref t) (TRef d1 T) ({♦})

| t_refat : forall Γ φ φd Σ t1 t2 T d T1 d1 d2,
    has_type Γ φd Σ t1 T d ->
    ♦∉ d ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (t2) (TRef d1 T1) (d2) ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t2)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t1) (d2) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (trefat t1 t2) (TRef (d) T) (d2)

| t_deref: forall Γ φ Σ T d d1 t,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t (TRef d1 T) d ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    d1 ⊑↑ φ ->





    kill_sep (local_locs t) d1 ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ !t T d1

| t_assign: forall Γ φ φd Σ T t1 d d1 t2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ t1 (TRef d1 T) d ->
    has_type Γ φd Σ t2 T d1 ->
    ♦∉ d1 ->
    (qdiff φ (local_locs t1)) = φd ->
    kill_sep (local_locs t2) (d) ->
    has_type Γ φ Σ (tassign t1 t2) TUnit ∅

| t_sub: forall Γ φ Σ e T1 d1 T2 d2,
    has_type Γ φ Σ e T1 d1 ->
    stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
    d2 ⊑↑ (φ ⊔ {♦}) ->
    kill_sep (local_locs e) d2 ->

    ♦∉ d1 ->



    closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T2 ->

Definition store := list (option (list (tm))).

Inductive step : tm -> store -> tm -> store -> Prop :=

| step_ttapp: forall t σ,
  step (ttapp (ttabs t)) σ (t <~ᵗ (ttabs t); tunit) σ
| step_beta : forall t v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tapp (tabs t) v) σ (t <~ᵗ (tabs t); v) σ
| step_ref : forall v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tref v) σ (&‖σ‖) ((Some [v]) :: σ)
| step_refat: forall v l o s σ,
    value v ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->

    step (trefat v &(l, o)) σ &(l, ‖s‖) (cinsert σ l (v))
| step_deref : forall σ l o s v,
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    indexr o s = Some (v) ->
    step (! &(l, o)) σ v σ
| step_assign : forall σ l o v s,
    l < ‖σ‖ ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    o < ‖s‖ ->
    value v ->
    step (tassign &(l, o) v) σ tunit (supdate σ l o v)
| step_twithr : forall σ v t,
    value v ->
    step (twithr v t) σ (twithc (‖σ‖) (t <~ᵗ tunit; (&‖σ‖))) ((Some [v]) :: σ)

    value v ->
    step (twithc l v) σ v (update σ l None)

| step_c_tapp: forall t t' σ σ',
  step t σ t' σ' ->
  step (ttapp t)  σ (ttapp t') σ'
| step_c_ref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step (tref t) σ (tref t') σ'
| step_c_refat_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    value t2 ->
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_refat_r : forall t1 t2 t2' σ σ',
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1 t2') σ'
| step_c_deref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step !t σ !t' σ'
| step_c_app_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tapp t1 t2) σ (tapp t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_app_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tapp v t2) σ (tapp v t2') σ'
| step_c_assign_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tassign t1 t2) σ (tassign t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_assign_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tassign v t2) σ (tassign v t2') σ'
| step_c_twithr_l : forall t1 t2 t1' σ σ',
  step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
  step (twithr t1 t2) σ (twithr t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_twithc : forall l t t' σ σ',

  step (twithc l t) σ (twithc l t') σ'

Definition relation (X : Type)(Y: Type) := X -> Y -> X ->  Y -> Prop.

Definition deterministic {X : Type}{Y: Type} (R : relation X Y) :=
  forall (x x1 x2 : X) (y y1 y2: Y), R x y x1 y1 -> R x y x2 y2 -> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2.

Definition root' (c : option (list tm)) : (option tm) :=

Definition squish' (σ : store) : list (option tm) := map (root') σ.

Definition indexr' {X : Type} (n : nat) (l : option (list X)) : option X :=

Fixpoint sindexr' {X : Type} (l : loc) (o : offset) (σ : list (option (list X))) : option X :=
  match σ with
    | [] => None
    | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then indexr' o a else sindexr' l o σ'

Import QualNotations.

Local Open Scope qualifiers.

Import OpeningNotations.

Local Open Scope opening.

Import SplicingNotations.

Local Open Scope splicing.

Import SubstitutionNotations.

Local Open Scope substitutions.

Inductive disjointq (Σ Σ' : senv) : qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| disj_bot : forall q,
    disjointq Σ Σ' q ∅
| disj_loc : forall T q q',
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    ♦∉ q ->
    Σ' = [(T,q)] :: Σ ->
    disjointq Σ Σ' q' (&!‖Σ‖)
.

Arguments disj_loc { Σ Σ' }.

Notation " S → T ∋ q ⊕ q'" := (disjointq S T q q') (at level 10).

Definition CtxOK (Γ : tenv) (φ : qual) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (σ : store) : Prop :=
  qdom' σ ⊑↑ qdom Σ /\ ‖ σ ‖ = ‖ Σ ‖ /\
     φ ⊑↑ (qdom Σ) /\
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) ϰ↑ /\
  kill_sep ϰ φ /\
  forall l o cty T q,
  (l ∈ₗ ϰ -> indexr l σ = Some None) /\ (~(l∈ₗ ϰ) ->
    l ∈ₗ φ ->
    indexr l Σ = Some cty ->
    (exists ctm, (indexr l σ = Some (Some ctm) /\ (‖ cty ‖) = (‖ ctm ‖)) /\
    (indexr o cty = Some (T,q) ->  (exists v, indexr o ctm = Some v /\
      value v /\ (q ⊑↑ φ -> vtp Σ ϰ φ v T q))))

  )
.

Fixpoint wf_step (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | ttapp t1 => wf_step t1
  | tabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | tapp t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | tref t1 => wf_step t1
  | trefat t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t1 = ∅ \/ (value t2))
  | tderef t1 => wf_step t1
  | tassign t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithr t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithc l t1 => wf_step t1
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition wf_store (σ : store) : Prop :=
    forall l o v, sindexr' l o σ = Some (v) -> wf_step v /\ value v.

Inductive envUpdate (Σ : senv) (φ : qual) (ϰ : qual) (LC : qual): senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| env_phi : forall Σ',

    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->
    ‖Σ'‖ = ‖Σ‖ ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ ϰ
| env_fresh : forall T q,
    kill_sep ϰ q ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC ([(T,q)] :: Σ) (φ ⊔ &!(‖Σ‖)) ϰ
| env_kill : forall l,
    l < (‖Σ‖) ->
    l ∈ₗ LC ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ (q_remove Σ l φ) (ϰ ⊔ &!l)
.

Inductive preserve (Γ : tenv) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (φ : qual) (LC : qual) (t' : tm) (T : ty) (d : qual) (σ' : store) : Prop :=
| Preserve : forall Σ' d' φ' ϰ',
    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->

    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ' ϰ' ->
    d' ⊑↑ φ' ->
    wf_senv Σ' ->
    CtxOK Γ φ' Σ' ϰ' σ' ->
    Σ → Σ' ∋ d ⊕ d'  ->
    has_type Γ φ' Σ' t' T (d ⋓ d') ->

    wf_store σ' ->
    wf_step t' ->
    preserve Γ Σ ϰ φ LC t' T d σ'.

Arguments Preserve {Γ Σ ϰ φ LC t' T d σ'}.

(* ===== Partial proof infrastructure (helper definitions and lemmas) ===== *)

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Arith.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Require Import Psatz.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Compare_dec.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import vars.

Fixpoint update {A} (σ : list A) (l : nat) (v : A) : list A :=
  match σ with
  | [] => σ
  | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then (v :: σ') else (a :: (update σ' l v ))
  end.

Fixpoint insert {A} (σ : list A) (l : nat) (v : A) : list A :=
  match σ with
  | [] => σ
  | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then (a :: v :: σ') else (a :: (insert σ' l v ))
  end.

Fixpoint indexr {X : Type} (n : nat) (l : list X) : option X :=
  match l with
    | [] => None
    | a :: l' =>
      if (Nat.eqb n (length l')) then Some a else indexr n l'
  end.

Fixpoint delete_nth (n : nat) {A} (l : list A) : list A :=
  match l with
  | nil       => nil
  | cons x xs => if (Nat.eqb n (length xs)) then xs else x :: (delete_nth n xs)
  end.

Definition slength {A} (l : option (list A)) : nat :=
  match l with
  | None => 0
  | Some l' => length l'
  end.

Definition update' {A} (s : option (list A)) (o : nat) (v : A) : option (list A) :=
  match s with
  | None => None
  | Some c => Some (update c o v)
  end.

Fixpoint supdate {A} (σ : list (option (list (A)))) (l : loc) (o : offset) (v : A) : list (option (list (A))) :=
  match σ with
  | [] => σ
  | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then ( (update' a o v) :: σ') else (a :: (supdate σ' l o v ))
  end.

Definition insert' {A} (s : option (list A)) (v : A) : option (list A) :=
  match s with
  | None => None
  | Some c => Some (v :: c)
  end.

Fixpoint cinsert {A} (σ : list (option (list (A)))) (l : loc) (v : A) : list (option (list (A))) :=
  match σ with
  | [] => σ
  | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then
        insert' a v :: σ'
      else (a :: (cinsert σ' l v ))
  end.

Fixpoint sindexr {X : Type} (l : loc) (o : offset) (σ : list (list X)) : option X :=
  match σ with
    | [] => None
    | a :: σ' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length σ')) then indexr o a else sindexr l o σ'
  end.

Fixpoint sinsert {A} (s : list ((list (A)))) (l : loc) (x : A) : list (list (A)) :=
  match s with
  | [] => s
  | c :: s' =>
      if (Nat.eqb l (length s')) then
        ((x :: c) :: s')
      else (c :: (sinsert s' l x ))
  end.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Arith.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Require Import Psatz.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Compare_dec.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import vars.

Require Import env.

Require Import nats.

Require Import qualifiers.

Require Import boolean.

Require Import lang.

Import QualNotations.

Local Open Scope qualifiers.

Definition env := fun (p : Type) => list p.

Definition tenv := env (binding * bool * ty * qual).

Definition senvs := env (ty * qual).

Definition senv := env (senvs).

Definition getquals (p : ty * qual) : qual :=
  match p with
  | (_ , q) => q
  end.

Notation "p .q" := (map getquals p) (at level 75).

Fixpoint qunify (lq : list qual) : (qual) :=
  match lq with
  | [] => ∅
  | q :: tl => qor q (qunify tl)
  end.

Definition squish (Σ : senv) : senvs := map (fun x => (TUnit, qunify (x.q))) Σ.

Class qenv {p : Type} : Type := {

  qenv_q : p -> qual;

  qenv_qn : qual -> nats;
  qenv_Qn : Qual -> Nats;
}.

#[export] Instance tenv_qenv : @qenv (binding * bool * ty * qual) := {
  qenv_q := snd; qenv_qn := qfvs; qenv_Qn := qfvs;
}.

#[export] Instance senv_qenv : @qenv (ty * qual) := {
  qenv_q := snd; qenv_qn := qlocs; qenv_Qn := qlocs;
}.

Definition wf_senvs (L : nat) (c : senvs) : Prop :=
  forall x T q, indexr x c = Some (T, q) -> ♦∉ q /\ closed_ty 0 0 L T /\ closed_Qual 0 0 L q↑
.

Definition wf_senvc (L : nat) (c : senvs) : Prop := ‖ c ‖ > 0 /\ wf_senvs L c.

Definition wf_senv (Σ : senv) : Prop := forall l c,
  indexr l Σ = Some c -> wf_senvc (‖Σ‖) c
.

Inductive wf_tenv : tenv -> senv -> Prop :=
  | wf_tenv_nil : forall Σ, wf_senv Σ -> wf_tenv [] Σ
  | wf_tenv_cons : forall Γ Σ bd fr T q,
      wf_tenv Γ Σ ->
      closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T ->
      closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
      wf_tenv ((bd, fr, T, q) :: Γ) Σ
.

Inductive wf_qenv {p : Type} `{qenv p} : (env p) -> Prop :=
  | wf_qenv_nil : wf_qenv []
  | wf_qenv_cons : forall E a,
      wf_qenv E ->
      closed_Nats (‖E‖) (qenv_Qn (qenv_q a) ↑) ->
      wf_qenv (a :: E).

Lemma n_or_empty_r : forall f, n_or f n_empty = f.
Proof. intros. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. unfold n_or, n_empty. rewrite orb_false_r. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma n_or_empty_l : forall f, n_or n_empty f = f.
Proof. intros. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. unfold n_or, n_empty. rewrite orb_false_l. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma n_or_comm : forall f g, n_or f g = n_or g f.
Proof. intros. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. unfold n_or. destruct (f x),(g x); reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma n_or_assoc : forall f g h, n_or (n_or f g) h = n_or f (n_or g h).
Proof. intros. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. unfold n_or. destruct (f x),(g x),(h x); reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma n_and_comm : forall f g, n_and f g = n_and g f.
Proof. intros. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. unfold n_and. destruct (f x),(g x); reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma qor_comm : forall a b, qor a b = qor b a.
Proof.
  intros. apply qual_ext.
  - unfold qor, qfresh. simpl. apply orb_comm.
  - unfold qor, qfvs. simpl. apply n_or_comm.
  - unfold qor, qbvs. simpl. apply n_or_comm.
  - unfold qor, qlocs. simpl. apply n_or_comm.
Qed.
Lemma qor_assoc : forall a b c, qor (qor a b) c = qor a (qor b c).
Proof.
  intros. apply qual_ext.
  - unfold qor, qfresh. simpl. rewrite orb_assoc. reflexivity.
  - unfold qor, qfvs. simpl. apply n_or_assoc.
  - unfold qor, qbvs. simpl. apply n_or_assoc.
  - unfold qor, qlocs. simpl. apply n_or_assoc.
Qed.
Lemma qor_empty_r : forall d, qor d q_empty = d.
Proof.
  intros. apply qual_ext.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qfresh. simpl. rewrite orb_false_r. reflexivity.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qfvs. simpl. apply n_or_empty_r.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qbvs. simpl. apply n_or_empty_r.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qlocs. simpl. apply n_or_empty_r.
Qed.
Lemma qor_empty_l : forall d, qor q_empty d = d.
Proof.
  intros. apply qual_ext.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qfresh. simpl. reflexivity.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qfvs. simpl. apply n_or_empty_l.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qbvs. simpl. apply n_or_empty_l.
  - unfold qor, q_empty, qlocs. simpl. apply n_or_empty_l.
Qed.

Lemma Subq_refl : forall q, Subq q q.
Proof. intros q. unfold Subq, N_sub, N_lift. repeat split; intros; auto. Qed.
Lemma Subq_trans : forall a b c, Subq a b -> Subq b c -> Subq a c.
Proof.
  intros a b c [H1 [H2 [H3 H4]]] [G1 [G2 [G3 G4]]].
  unfold Subq; simpl. split.
  - intros H; apply G1; apply H1; auto.
  - split.
    + intros x Hx; apply G2; apply H2; auto.
    + split.
      * intros x Hx; apply G3; apply H3; auto.
      * intros x Hx; apply G4; apply H4; auto.
Qed.
Lemma subq_refl : forall q, q ⊑ q.
Proof.
  intros. unfold subq. repeat split; auto.
  - unfold Is_true, implb. destruct (qfresh q); reflexivity.
  - unfold n_sub; auto. - unfold n_sub; auto. - unfold n_sub; auto.
Qed.
Lemma Is_true_implb_iff : forall a b : bool, Is_true (implb a b) <-> (a = true -> b = true).
Proof. intros a b. unfold Is_true. destruct a; destruct b; simpl; intuition congruence. Qed.
Lemma subq_trans : forall a b c, a ⊑ b -> b ⊑ c -> a ⊑ c.
Proof.
  intros a b c [H1 [H2 [H3 H4]]] [G1 [G2 [G3 G4]]].
  unfold subq; simpl. split.
  - apply Is_true_implb_iff. intros H.
    apply Is_true_implb_iff in H1. apply Is_true_implb_iff in G1.
    apply G1. apply H1. exact H.
  - split.
    + unfold n_sub in *; intros x Hx; apply G2; apply H2; auto.
    + split.
      * unfold n_sub in *; intros x Hx; apply G3; apply H3; auto.
      * unfold n_sub in *; intros x Hx; apply G4; apply H4; auto.
Qed.

Lemma Q_lift_fresh : forall q, qfresh (Q_lift q) = Is_true (qfresh q).
Proof. intro. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Q_lift_fvs : forall q, qfvs (Q_lift q) = N_lift (qfvs q).
Proof. intro. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Q_lift_bvs : forall q, qbvs (Q_lift q) = N_lift (qbvs q).
Proof. intro. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma Q_lift_locs : forall q, qlocs (Q_lift q) = N_lift (qlocs q).
Proof. intro. reflexivity. Qed.

Definition dfr (q : qual) : qual := (false, qfvs q, qbvs q, qlocs q).
Definition qsub (q q0 q1 : qual) : qual :=
  ( orb (orb (qfresh q) (andb (qfvs q 0) (qfresh q0))) (andb (qfvs q 1) (qfresh q1)),
    (fun x => qfvs q (S (S x))),
    qbvs q,
    (fun x => orb (orb (qlocs q x) (andb (qfvs q 0) (qlocs q0 x)))
                  (andb (qfvs q 1) (qlocs q1 x))) ).

Fixpoint tsub (T : ty) (U0 U1 : ty) (q0 q1 : qual) : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop => TTop
  | TVar (varF i) => match i with 0 => U0 | 1 => U1 | S (S j) => TVar (varF j) end
  | TVar (varB i) => TVar (varB i)
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2 => TAll (qsub d1 q0 q1) (qsub d2 q0 q1) (tsub T1 U0 U1 q0 q1) (tsub T2 U0 U1 q0 q1)
  | TUnit => TUnit
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2 => TFun (qsub d1 q0 q1) (qsub d2 q0 q1) (tsub T1 U0 U1 q0 q1) (tsub T2 U0 U1 q0 q1)
  | TRef d T => TRef (qsub d q0 q1) (tsub T U0 U1 q0 q1)
  end.

Fixpoint tmsub (t : tm) (u0 u1 : tm) : tm :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t1 => ttabs (tmsub t1 u0 u1)
  | ttapp t1 => ttapp (tmsub t1 u0 u1)
  | tunit => tunit
  | tvar (varF i) => match i with 0 => u0 | 1 => u1 | S (S j) => tvar (varF j) end
  | tvar (varB i) => tvar (varB i)
  | tabs t1 => tabs (tmsub t1 u0 u1)
  | tapp t1 t2 => tapp (tmsub t1 u0 u1) (tmsub t2 u0 u1)
  | tloc l o => tloc l o
  | tref t1 => tref (tmsub t1 u0 u1)
  | trefat t1 t2 => trefat (tmsub t1 u0 u1) (tmsub t2 u0 u1)
  | tderef t1 => tderef (tmsub t1 u0 u1)

395	Lemma qsub_closed_qual : forall b f l (q q0 q1 : qual),
396	  closed_Qual b (f+2) l (Q_lift q) -> closed_Qual 0 0 l (Q_lift q0) -> closed_Qual 0 0 l (Q_lift q1) ->
397	  closed_Qual b f l (Q_lift (qsub q q0 q1)).

400	  unfold closed_Qual. repeat split; unfold closed_Nats in *.
401	  - intros x Hx. rewrite Q_lift_fvs in Hx. rewrite qsub_fvs in Hx. apply Hf in Hx. lia.
402	  - intros x Hx. rewrite Q_lift_bvs in Hx. rewrite qsub_bvs in Hx. apply Hb in Hx. exact Hx.

404	    rewrite qsub_locs in Hx. apply orb_true_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
405	    + apply orb_true_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx|Hx].
406	      * apply Hl in Hx. exact Hx.

413	  orb (orb fa (andb fa0 f0)) (andb fa1 f1) = true -> orb (orb fb (andb fb0 f0)) (andb fb1 f1) = true.

417	  orb (orb la (andb fa0 l0)) (andb fa1 l1) = true -> orb (orb lb (andb fb0 l0)) (andb fb1 l1) = true.

422	Proof.
423	  intros a b q0 q1 [Hf [Hfa [Hba Hla]]]. unfold Subq. repeat split.
424	  - intros Hx. rewrite Q_lift_fresh in Hx. apply Is_true_eq_true in Hx.
425	    rewrite qsub_fresh in Hx. rewrite Q_lift_fresh. apply Is_true_eq_left. rewrite qsub_fresh.
426	    eapply qsub_fresh_mono.
427	    + intros H. apply Is_true_eq_true. apply Hf. rewrite Q_lift_fresh. apply Is_true_eq_left. exact H.
428	    + intros H. apply Hfa. exact H.
429	    + intros H. apply Hfa. exact H.
430	    + exact Hx.
431	  - intros x Hx. rewrite Q_lift_fvs in Hx. change (qfvs a (S (S x)) = true) in Hx.
432	    rewrite Q_lift_fvs. change (qfvs b (S (S x)) = true). apply Hfa. exact Hx.
433	  - intros x Hx. rewrite Q_lift_bvs in Hx. change (qbvs a x = true) in Hx.
434	    rewrite Q_lift_bvs. change (qbvs b x = true). apply Hba. exact Hx.
435	  - intros x Hx. rewrite Q_lift_locs in Hx. change (qlocs (qsub a q0 q1) x = true) in Hx.
436	    rewrite qsub_locs in Hx. rewrite Q_lift_locs. change (qlocs (qsub b q0 q1) x = true).
437	    rewrite qsub_locs. eapply qsub_locs_mono.
438	    + intros H; apply Hla; exact H.
439	    + intros H; apply Hfa; exact H.
440	    + intros H; apply Hfa; exact H.
441	    + exact Hx.

444	Lemma qsub_qor : forall a b q0 q1,
445	  qsub (qor a b) q0 q1 = qor (qsub a q0 q1) (qsub b q0 q1).
446	Proof.
447	  intros a b q0 q1. apply qual_ext.
448	  - unfold qsub, qor, qfresh, qfvs, qbvs, qlocs, n_or. cbn.
449	    remember (fst (fst (fst a))) as A eqn:EA.
450	    remember (fst (fst (fst b))) as B eqn:EB.
451	    remember (snd (fst (fst a)) 0) as a0 eqn:Ea0.
452	    remember (snd (fst (fst b)) 0) as b0 eqn:Eb0.
453	    remember (snd (fst (fst a)) 1) as a1 eqn:Ea1.
454	    remember (snd (fst (fst b)) 1) as b1 eqn:Eb1.
455	    remember (fst (fst (fst q0))) as F0 eqn:EF0.
456	    remember (fst (fst (fst q1))) as F1 eqn:EF1.
457	    destruct A, B, a0, b0, a1, b1, F0, F1; reflexivity.
458	  - unfold qsub, qor, qfvs, n_or. cbn. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. reflexivity.
459	  - unfold qsub, qor, qbvs, n_or. cbn. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. reflexivity.
460	  - unfold qsub, qor, qfresh, qfvs, qbvs, qlocs, n_or. cbn.
461	    apply functional_extensionality. intro x.
462	    remember (fst (fst (fst a))) as A eqn:EA.
463	    remember (fst (fst (fst b))) as B eqn:EB.
464	    remember (snd (fst (fst a)) 0) as a0 eqn:Ea0.
465	    remember (snd (fst (fst b)) 0) as b0 eqn:Eb0.
466	    remember (snd (fst (fst a)) 1) as a1 eqn:Ea1.
467	    remember (snd (fst (fst b)) 1) as b1 eqn:Eb1.
468	    remember (snd a x) as La eqn:ELa.
469	    remember (snd b x) as Lb eqn:ELb.
470	    remember (snd q0 x) as L0 eqn:EL0.
471	    remember (snd q1 x) as L1 eqn:EL1.
472	    destruct A, B, a0, b0, a1, b1, La, Lb, L0, L1; reflexivity.
473	Qed.

Lemma qsub_fresh : forall q q0 q1,
  qfresh (qsub q q0 q1) = orb (orb (qfresh q) (andb (qfvs q 0) (qfresh q0))) (andb (qfvs q 1) (qfresh q1)).
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma qsub_fvs : forall q q0 q1, qfvs (qsub q q0 q1) = (fun x => qfvs q (S (S x))).
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma qsub_bvs : forall q q0 q1, qbvs (qsub q q0 q1) = qbvs q.
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma qsub_locs : forall q q0 q1,
  qlocs (qsub q q0 q1) = (fun x => orb (orb (qlocs q x) (andb (qfvs q 0) (qlocs q0 x))) (andb (qfvs q 1) (qlocs q1 x))).
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma qsub_closed : forall q q0 q1, qfvs q = n_empty -> qsub q q0 q1 = q.
Proof.
  intros q q0 q1 H. apply qual_ext.
  - rewrite qsub_fresh. rewrite H. unfold n_empty. simpl. repeat rewrite ?orb_false_r. reflexivity.
  - rewrite qsub_fvs. rewrite H. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. reflexivity.
  - rewrite qsub_bvs. reflexivity.
  - rewrite qsub_locs. rewrite H. unfold n_empty. simpl.
    apply functional_extensionality. intro x. repeat rewrite ?orb_false_r. reflexivity.
Qed.

    unfold qfvs, n_one, n_empty. simpl. reflexivity.

Lemma closed_Qual_weaken : forall b f l q b' f',
  closed_Qual b f l q -> b <= b' -> f <= f' -> closed_Qual b' f' l q.
Proof.
  intros b f l q b' f' [H1 [H2 H3]] Hb Hf. unfold closed_Qual. repeat split;
  unfold closed_Nats in *.
  - intros x Hx. apply H1 in Hx. lia.
  - intros x Hx. apply H2 in Hx. lia.
  - intros x Hx. apply H3 in Hx. lia.
Qed.
Lemma closed_ty_weaken : forall b f l T b' f',
  closed_ty b f l T -> b <= b' -> f <= f' -> closed_ty b' f' l T.
Proof.
  intros b f l T. revert b f l. induction T; intros b f l b' f' Hc Hb Hf; inversion Hc; subst.
  - apply cl_TTop.
  - apply cl_ttvarf. lia.
  - apply cl_ttvarb. lia.
  - eapply cl_TAll.
    + eapply closed_Qual_weaken with (b:=b) (f:=f); eauto.
    + eapply closed_Qual_weaken with (b:=S (S b)) (f:=f); eauto; lia.
    + eapply (IHT1 b f l b' f'); eauto.
    + eapply (IHT2 (S (S b)) f l (S (S b')) f'); eauto; lia.
  - apply cl_TUnit.
  - eapply cl_TFun.
    + eapply closed_Qual_weaken with (b:=b) (f:=f); eauto.
    + eapply closed_Qual_weaken with (b:=S (S b)) (f:=f); eauto; lia.
    + eapply (IHT1 b f l b' f'); eauto.
    + eapply (IHT2 (S (S b)) f l (S (S b')) f'); eauto; lia.
  - eapply cl_TRef.
    + eapply (IHT b f l b' f'); eauto.
    + eapply closed_Qual_weaken with (b:=b) (f:=f); eauto.
Qed.
Lemma closed_tm_weaken : forall b f l t b' f',
  closed_tm b f l t -> b <= b' -> f <= f' -> closed_tm b' f' l t.
Proof.
  intros b f l t b' f' H. revert b' f'.
  induction H; intros b' f' Hb Hf.
  - apply cl_ttabs. apply IHclosed_tm; lia.
  - apply cl_ttapp. apply IHclosed_tm; lia.
  - apply cl_tsct.
  - apply cl_tvarb. lia.
  - apply cl_tvarf. lia.
  - apply cl_tabs. apply IHclosed_tm; lia.
  - apply cl_tapp. apply IHclosed_tm1; lia. apply IHclosed_tm2; lia.
  - apply cl_tloc. lia.
  - apply cl_tref. apply IHclosed_tm; lia.
  - apply cl_trefat. apply IHclosed_tm1; lia. apply IHclosed_tm2; lia.
  - apply cl_tderef. apply IHclosed_tm; lia.
  - apply cl_tassign. apply IHclosed_tm1; lia. apply IHclosed_tm2; lia.
  - apply cl_twithr. apply IHclosed_tm1; lia. apply IHclosed_tm2; lia.
  - apply cl_twithc. lia. apply IHclosed_tm; lia.
Qed.

    remember (fst (fst (fst a))) as A eqn:EA.
    remember (fst (fst (fst b))) as B eqn:EB.
    remember (snd (fst (fst a)) 0) as a0 eqn:Ea0.

    remember (snd (fst (fst a)) 1) as a1 eqn:Ea1.
    remember (snd (fst (fst b)) 1) as b1 eqn:Eb1.

  - unfold qsub, qor, qbvs, n_or. cbn. apply functional_extensionality. intro x. reflexivity.
  - unfold qsub, qor, qfresh, qfvs, qbvs, qlocs, n_or. cbn.
    apply functional_extensionality. intro x.
    remember (fst (fst (fst a))) as A eqn:EA.
    remember (fst (fst (fst b))) as B eqn:EB.
    remember (snd (fst (fst a)) 0) as a0 eqn:Ea0.
    remember (snd (fst (fst b)) 0) as b0 eqn:Eb0.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import vars.

Require Import env.

Require Import nats.

Require Import qualifiers.

Require Import boolean.

Import QualNotations.

Local Open Scope qualifiers.

Inductive ty : Type :=
| TTop  : ty
| TVar  : var -> ty
| TAll  : qual -> qual -> ty ->  ty -> ty
| TUnit : ty
| TFun  : qual -> qual -> ty -> ty -> ty
| TRef  : qual -> ty -> ty
.

Inductive tm : Type :=
| ttabs   :   tm -> tm
| ttapp   : tm ->   tm
| tunit   : tm
| tvar    : var -> tm
| tabs    : tm  -> tm
| tapp    : tm  -> tm -> tm
| tloc    : loc -> offset -> tm
| tref    : tm  -> tm
| tderef  : tm  -> tm
| tassign : tm  -> tm -> tm
| trefat  : tm  -> tm -> tm
| twithr  : tm  -> tm -> tm
| twithc  : loc -> tm -> tm
.

Notation "& ( l , o )" := (tloc l o) (at level 0, right associativity).

Notation "& l"   := (tloc l 0) (at level 0, right associativity).

Notation "! t"   := (tderef t) (at level 0, right associativity).

Coercion tvar : var >-> tm.

Coercion TVar : var >-> ty.

Inductive binding :=
| bind_tm : binding
| bind_ty : binding
.

Definition extends {A} (l1 l2 : list A): Prop := exists l', l1 = l' ++ l2.

Notation "x ⊇ y" := (extends x y) (at level 75).

Notation "‖ x ‖" := (length x) (at level 10).

Fixpoint open_rec_tm (k : nat) (u : tm) (t : tm) {struct t} : tm :=
  match t with
  | ttabs   t => ttabs   (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t)
  | ttapp t   => ttapp (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | tunit            => tunit
  | tvar   (varF x) => tvar (varF x)
  | tvar   (varB x) => if Nat.eqb k x then u else tvar (varB x)
  | tabs    t       => tabs    (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t)
  | tapp    t1 t2   => tapp    (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | tloc l o        => tloc l o
  | tref    t       => tref    (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | trefat t1 t2    => trefat (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | tderef  t       => tderef  (open_rec_tm k u t)
  | tassign t1 t2   => tassign (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm k u t2)
  | twithr t1 t2    => twithr (open_rec_tm k u t1) (open_rec_tm (S (S k)) u t2)
  | twithc l t      => twithc l (open_rec_tm k u t)
  end
.

Definition open_tm (u u' t : tm) := open_rec_tm 1 u' (open_rec_tm 0 u t).

Definition open_tm' {A : Type} (env : list A) t := open_rec_tm 1 $(S (‖ env ‖)) (open_rec_tm 0 ($‖env‖) t).

Definition openq (u u' q : qual) : qual := open_qual 1 u' (open_qual 0 u q).

Definition openq' {A} (env : list A) q  := openq ($!‖env‖) $!(S (‖env‖)) q.

Fixpoint open_rec_ty (k : nat)(U:  ty) (d' : qual) (T : ty) : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop              => TTop
  | TVar (varF x)     => TVar (varF x)
  | TVar (varB x)     => if Nat.eqb k x then U else (TVar (varB x))
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2  => TAll (open_qual k d' d1) (open_qual (S (S k)) d' d2) (open_rec_ty k U d' T1) (open_rec_ty (S (S k)) U d' T2)

  end.

Module OpeningNotations.

Declare Scope opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> u ]]ᵗ t"       := (open_rec_tm k u t) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> U ~ d ]]ᵀ T"   := (open_rec_ty k U d T) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "[[ k ~> q' ]]ᵈ q"      := (open_qual k q' q) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "t <~ᵗ q ; q'"          := (open_tm q q' t) (at level 10, q at next level) : opening.

Notation "T <~ᵀ U ~ du ; V ~ dv" := (open_ty U du V dv  T) (at level 10, U, du at next level) : opening.

Notation "q <~ᵈ q' ; q''"        := (openq q' q'' q) (at level 10, q' at next level) : opening.

Notation "t <~²ᵗ g"              := (open_tm' g t) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "T <~²ᵀ g"              := (open_ty' g T) (at level 10) : opening.

Notation "q <~²ᵈ g"              := (openq' g q) (at level 10) : opening.

End OpeningNotations.

Import OpeningNotations.

Local Open Scope opening.

Fixpoint ty_size (T : ty) : nat :=
  match T with
  | TTop            => 0
  | TVar _          => 0
  | TAll _ _ T1 T2  => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TUnit           => 0
  | TFun  _ _ T1 T2 => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TRef  _ T       => S (ty_size T)
  end.

Fixpoint ty_size (T : ty) : nat :=
  match T with
  | TTop            => 0
  | TVar _          => 0
  | TAll _ _ T1 T2  => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TUnit           => 0
  | TFun  _ _ T1 T2 => S (ty_size T1 + ty_size T2)
  | TRef  _ T       => S (ty_size T)
  end.

Local Open Scope opening.

Import SplicingNotations.

Local Open Scope splicing.

Import SubstitutionNotations.

Local Open Scope substitutions.

Inductive qstp : tenv -> senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| qs_sq : forall Γ Σ d1 d2,
    d1 ⊑↑ d2 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) d2↑ ->
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2

| qs_self : forall Γ Σ f df T1 d1 T2 d2,
    indexr f Γ = Some ((bind_tm, true, (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2), df)) ->
    closed_Qual 0 f (‖Σ‖) df↑ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    qstp Γ Σ (df ⊔ $!f) $!f

| qs_self_all : forall Γ Σ f df T1 d1 T2 d2,
    indexr f Γ = Some ((bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), df)) ->
    closed_Qual 0 f (‖Σ‖) df↑ ->
    ♦∉ df ->
    qstp Γ Σ (df ⊔ $!f) $!f

| qs_qvar : forall Γ Σ b U x q1,
    indexr x Γ = Some((bind_tm, b, U, q1)) ->
    closed_ty 0 x (‖Σ‖) U ->
    closed_Qual 0 x (‖Σ‖) q1↑ ->
    ♦∉ q1 ->
    qstp Γ Σ $!x q1

| qs_qvar_ty : forall Γ Σ b U x q1,
    indexr x Γ = Some((bind_ty, b, U, q1)) ->
    closed_ty 0 x (‖Σ‖) U ->
    closed_Qual 0 x (‖Σ‖) q1↑ ->
    ♦∉ q1 ->
    qstp Γ Σ $!x q1

| qs_cong : forall Γ Σ q d1 d2,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    qstp Γ Σ (q ⊔ d1) (q ⊔ d2)

| qs_trans : forall Γ Σ d1 d2 d3,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 -> qstp Γ Σ d2 d3 -> qstp Γ Σ d1 d3
.

Inductive stp : tenv -> senv -> ty -> qual -> ty -> qual -> Prop :=
| s_top : forall Γ Σ T d1 d2,
    closed_ty 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) T ->
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ T d1 TTop d2

| s_tvar_refl: forall Γ Σ x d1 d2 v,
    indexr x Γ = Some v ->
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ (TVar (varF x)) d1 (TVar (varF x)) d2

| s_tvar_trans: forall Γ Σ T1 T2 d0 d1 d2 x,
    indexr x Γ = Some((bind_ty, false, T1, d0)) ->
    closed_ty  0 0 (‖ Σ ‖) T1 ->
    stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ (TVar (varF x)) d1 T2 d2

| s_all: forall Γ Σ T1 T2 T3 T4 d1 d2 d3 d4 d5 d6,
    closed_ty 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) (TAll d3 d4 T3 T4) ->
    qstp Γ Σ d5 d6 ->
    stp Γ Σ T3 d3 T1 d1  ->
    stp ((bind_ty, false, T3, d3) :: (bind_tm, true, TAll d1 d2 T1 T2, {♦}) :: Γ) Σ (open_ty' Γ T2) (openq' Γ d2) (open_ty' Γ T4) (openq' Γ d4) ->
    stp Γ Σ (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) d5 (TAll d3 d4 T3 T4) d6

| s_base : forall Γ Σ d1 d2,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ TUnit d1 TUnit d2

| s_ref : forall Γ Σ T1 T2 q1 q2 d1 d2,
    qstp Γ Σ d1 d2 ->
    stp Γ Σ T1 ∅ T2 ∅ ->
    stp Γ Σ T2 ∅ T1 ∅ ->
    qstp Γ Σ q1 q2 ->
    qstp Γ Σ q2 q1 ->
    stp Γ Σ (TRef q1 T1) d1 (TRef q2 T2) d2

| s_fun : forall Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 T3 d3 T4 d4 d5 d6,
    closed_ty 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
    closed_ty 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) (TFun d3 d4 T3 T4) ->
    qstp Γ Σ d5 d6 ->
    stp Γ Σ T3 d3 T1 d1 ->
    stp ((bind_tm, false, T3,d3) :: (bind_tm, true, TFun d1 d2 T1 T2, {♦}) :: Γ) Σ (open_ty' Γ T2) (openq' Γ d2) (open_ty' Γ T4) (openq' Γ d4) ->
    stp Γ Σ (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) d5 (TFun d3 d4 T3 T4) d6

| s_trans : forall Γ Σ T1 T2 T3 d1 d2 d3,
    stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 -> stp Γ Σ T2 d2 T3 d3 -> stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T3 d3
.

Lemma wf_senvs_len_weaken : forall L (c:senvs),
  wf_senvs L c -> forall L', L <= L' -> wf_senvs L' c.
Proof.
  intros L c H L' Hle x T q Hx. destruct (H x T q Hx) as [Hq [Ht Hq']].
  split; [exact Hq|]. split.
  - eapply closed_ty_loc_weaken; [exact Ht|exact Hle].
  - eapply closed_Qual_loc_weaken; [exact Hq'|exact Hle].
Qed.

Lemma wf_senvc_len_weaken : forall L (c:senvs),
  wf_senvc L c -> forall L', L <= L' -> wf_senvc L' c.
Proof.
  intros L c [Hp Hw] L' Hle. split; [exact Hp|].
  eapply wf_senvs_len_weaken; eauto.
Qed.

Lemma wf_senvs_singleton : forall L T q,
  ♦∉ q -> closed_ty 0 0 L T -> closed_Qual 0 0 L q↑ ->
  forall L', L <= L' -> wf_senvs L' [(T,q)].
Proof.
  intros L T q Hf Ht Hq L' Hle x T' q' Hx.
  cbn [indexr] in Hx. destruct x.
  - cbn in Hx. injection Hx as -> ->. split; [exact Hf|]. split.
    + eapply closed_ty_loc_weaken; [exact Ht|exact Hle].
    + eapply closed_Qual_loc_weaken; [exact Hq|exact Hle].
  - simpl in Hx. discriminate Hx.
Qed.

Lemma wf_senv_cons : forall (Σ:senv) T q,
  wf_senv Σ -> ♦∉ q -> closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T -> closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
  wf_senv ([(T,q)] :: Σ).
Proof.
  intros Σ T q HΣ Hf Ht Hq l c Hc.
  rewrite indexr_cons in Hc.
  destruct (Nat.eqb l (length Σ)) eqn:E.
  - injection Hc as ->.
    split.
    + cbn. lia.
    + eapply wf_senvs_singleton; [exact Hf|exact Ht|exact Hq|lia].
  - apply wf_senvc_len_weaken with (L:=‖Σ‖); [apply HΣ; exact Hc|lia].
Qed.

Lemma sindexr_front_lookup : forall (c0:senvs) (Σ:senv) l o x,
  sindexr l o Σ = Some x -> sindexr l o (c0 :: Σ) = Some x.
Proof.
  intros. rewrite sindexr_lt_head.
  - exact H.
  - eapply sindexr_Some_lt; eauto.
Qed.

Require Import Arith.EqNat PeanoNat Coq.Arith.Arith Coq.Bool.Bool Coq.Program.Equality Coq.Lists.List FunctionalExtensionality Coq.Logic.PropExtensionality Psatz ZArith Coq.Arith.Compare_dec.
Require Import vars env nats qualifiers boolean lang qenv ops killsep rules vtp_subst.
Require Import Base2.
Import QualNotations. Local Open Scope qualifiers.
Import OpeningNotations. Local Open Scope opening.
Import SplicingNotations. Local Open Scope splicing.
Import SubstitutionNotations. Local Open Scope substitutions.

Lemma qand_subq_mono_l : forall a b c, a ⊑↑ b -> qand a c ⊑↑ qand b c.
Proof.
  intros a b c [Hf [H1 [H2 H3]]]. unfold N_sub in H1,H2,H3. unfold Subq. split.
  - change (Is_true (qfresh a && qfresh c) -> Is_true (qfresh b && qfresh c)).
    intros H. apply Is_true_andb in H. destruct H as [Ha Hc].
    apply Is_true_andb. split; [apply Hf; exact Ha|exact Hc].
  - split.
    + change (forall x, (qfvs a x && qfvs c x) = true -> (qfvs b x && qfvs c x) = true).
      intros x Hx. apply andb_true_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx Hc].
      apply andb_true_iff. split; [apply H1; exact Hx|exact Hc].
    + split.
      * change (forall x, (qbvs a x && qbvs c x) = true -> (qbvs b x && qbvs c x) = true).
        intros x Hx. apply andb_true_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx Hc].
        apply andb_true_iff. split; [apply H2; exact Hx|exact Hc].
      * change (forall x, (qlocs a x && qlocs c x) = true -> (qlocs b x && qlocs c x) = true).
        intros x Hx. apply andb_true_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [Hx Hc].
        apply andb_true_iff. split; [apply H3; exact Hx|exact Hc].
Qed.

Lemma kill_sep_subq_l : forall ϰ φ φ', kill_sep ϰ φ -> φ' ⊑↑ φ -> kill_sep ϰ φ'.
Proof.
  intros ϰ φ φ' Hk Hsub. unfold kill_sep in *.
  eapply Subq_trans; [|exact Hk].
  apply qand_subq_mono_l. exact Hsub.
Qed.

Lemma closed_Qual_qor : forall b f l (a c:qual),
  closed_Qual b f l (Q_lift a) -> closed_Qual b f l (Q_lift c) ->
  closed_Qual b f l (Q_lift (qor a c)).
Proof.
  intros b f l a c Ha Hc. destruct Ha as [Haf [Hab Hal]]. destruct Hc as [Hcf [Hcb Hcl]].
  unfold closed_Qual. split; [|split].
  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx. unfold N_lift in *. simpl in Hx.

  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx. unfold N_lift in *. simpl in Hx.
    apply orb_true_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [H|H]; [apply Hab in H|apply Hcb in H]; lia.
  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx. unfold N_lift in *. simpl in Hx.
    apply orb_true_iff in Hx. destruct Hx as [H|H]; [apply Hal in H|apply Hcl in H]; lia.
Qed.

Import SubstitutionNotations. Local Open Scope substitutions.

Lemma q_remove'_locs_l_false : forall (Σ:senv) l φ n,
  l < n -> qlocs (q_remove' Σ l φ n) l = false.
Proof.
  intros Σ l φ n. induction n as [|n IH]; intros Hlt.
  - lia.
  - cbn [q_remove'].
    change (qlocs (if qlocs φ n && negb (n_one n l) then q_remove' Σ l φ n ⊔ &!n else q_remove' Σ l φ n) l = false).
    destruct (qlocs φ n && negb (n_one n l)) eqn:E.
    + change (n_or (qlocs (q_remove' Σ l φ n)) (n_one n) l = false).
      apply orb_false_iff. split.
      * apply IH. lia.
      * apply andb_true_iff in E. destruct E as [_ Hneg].
        unfold negb in Hneg. destruct (n_one n l); [discriminate Hneg|reflexivity].
    + apply IH. lia.
Qed.

Lemma q_remove_qlocs_l_false : forall (Σ:senv) l φ,
  l < ‖Σ‖ -> qlocs (q_remove Σ l φ) l = false.
Proof.
  intros. unfold q_remove, qor, qlocs. simpl.
  rewrite q_remove'_locs_l_false; [reflexivity|exact H].
Qed.

Lemma kill_sep_amp_add : forall ϰ (d:qual) l,
  kill_sep ϰ d -> qlocs d l = false -> kill_sep (qor ϰ (&!l)) d.
Proof.
  intros ϰ d l Hk Hl. unfold kill_sep in *.
  rewrite qand_comm. rewrite qand_qor_distrib_l.
  assert (E1 : qand ϰ d = qand d ϰ) by apply qand_comm. rewrite E1.
  assert (E2 : qand (&!l) d = qand d (&!l)) by apply qand_comm. rewrite E2.
  rewrite qand_amp_empty; [|exact Hl].
  rewrite qor_empty_r. exact Hk.
Qed.

Lemma vtp_weaken_kappa_amp : forall Σ ϰ φ v T d l,
  vtp Σ ϰ φ v T d -> qlocs d l = false -> vtp Σ (qor ϰ (&!l)) φ v T d.
Proof.
  intros Σ ϰ φ v T d l H. induction H; intros Hl.
  - eapply vtp_tabs; eauto using kill_sep_amp_add.
  - eapply vtp_base; eauto using kill_sep_amp_add.
  - eapply vtp_loc; eauto using kill_sep_amp_add.
  - eapply vtp_abs; eauto using kill_sep_amp_add.

Require Import Arith.EqNat PeanoNat Coq.Arith.Arith Coq.Bool.Bool Coq.Program.Equality Coq.Lists.List FunctionalExtensionality Coq.Logic.PropExtensionality Psatz ZArith Coq.Arith.Compare_dec.
Require Import vars env nats qualifiers boolean lang qenv ops killsep rules vtp_subst.
Require Import Base2.
Import QualNotations. Local Open Scope qualifiers.
Import OpeningNotations. Local Open Scope opening.
Import SplicingNotations. Local Open Scope splicing.
Import SubstitutionNotations. Local Open Scope substitutions.

Lemma qfvs_open_qual_elim_f : forall k f (q:qual) x,
  qfvs (open_qual k ($!f) q) x = true -> qfvs q x = true \/ x = f.
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_qual in H. destruct (qbvs q k) eqn:E; simpl in H.
  - unfold qor, n_or in H. simpl in H. apply orb_true_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + left. exact H.
    + right. unfold n_one in H. apply Nat.eqb_eq in H. exact H.
  - left. exact H.
Qed.

Lemma qbvs_open_qual_elim_f : forall k f (q:qual) x,
  qbvs (open_qual k ($!f) q) x = true -> qbvs q x = true /\ x <> k.
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_qual in H. destruct (qbvs q k) eqn:E; simpl in H.
  - unfold qor, n_or in H. simpl in H. apply orb_true_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + unfold n_diff in H. apply andb_true_iff in H. destruct H as [H Hk].
      split; [exact H|]. unfold negb, n_one in Hk. destruct (Nat.eqb x k) eqn:Ex.
      * discriminate Hk.
      * apply Nat.eqb_neq in Ex. exact Ex.
    + unfold qbvs, n_empty in H. discriminate H.
  - split; [exact H|].
    intro Hx. subst x. rewrite E in H. discriminate H.
Qed.

Lemma qlocs_open_qual_elim_f : forall k f (q:qual) x,
  qlocs (open_qual k ($!f) q) x = true -> qlocs q x = true.
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_qual in H. destruct (qbvs q k) eqn:E; simpl in H.
  - unfold qor, n_or in H. simpl in H. apply orb_true_iff in H. destruct H as [H|H].
    + exact H.
    + unfold qlocs, n_empty in H. discriminate H.
  - exact H.
Qed.

Lemma qfvs_openq_pair_elim : forall k f (q:qual) x,
  qfvs (openq_pair k f q) x = true -> qfvs q x = true \/ x = f \/ x = S f.
Proof.
  intros. unfold openq_pair in H.
  destruct (qfvs_open_qual_elim_f (S k) (S f) (open_qual k ($!f) q) x H) as [H1|H1].
  - destruct (qfvs_open_qual_elim_f k f q x H1) as [H2|H2]; [left; exact H2|right; left; exact H2].
  - right; right; exact H1.
Qed.

Lemma qbvs_openq_pair_elim : forall k f (q:qual) x,
  qbvs (openq_pair k f q) x = true -> qbvs q x = true /\ x <> k /\ x <> S k.
Proof.
  intros. unfold openq_pair in H.
  destruct (qbvs_open_qual_elim_f (S k) (S f) (open_qual k ($!f) q) x H) as [H1 HS].
  destruct (qbvs_open_qual_elim_f k f q x H1) as [H2 Hk].
  split; [exact H2|]. split; [exact Hk|exact HS].
Qed.

Lemma qlocs_openq_pair_elim : forall k f (q:qual) x,
  qlocs (openq_pair k f q) x = true -> qlocs q x = true.
Proof.
  intros. unfold openq_pair in H.
  apply (qlocs_open_qual_elim_f k f q x).
  apply (qlocs_open_qual_elim_f (S k) (S f) (open_qual k ($!f) q) x H).
Qed.
EOF

Require Import Arith.EqNat PeanoNat Coq.Arith.Arith Coq.Bool.Bool Coq.Program.Equality Coq.Lists.List FunctionalExtensionality Coq.Logic.PropExtensionality Psatz ZArith Coq.Arith.Compare_dec.
Require Import vars env nats qualifiers boolean lang qenv ops killsep rules vtp_subst.
Require Import Base2.
Import QualNotations. Local Open Scope qualifiers.
Import OpeningNotations. Local Open Scope opening.
Import SplicingNotations. Local Open Scope splicing.
Import SubstitutionNotations. Local Open Scope substitutions.

Lemma qstp_subq_nl : forall Γ (Σ:senv) q d,
  no_lookup Γ -> qstp Γ Σ q d -> q ⊑↑ d.
Proof.
  intros Γ Σ q d Hnl H. induction H.
  - exact H.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - apply qor_subq_mono; [apply Subq_refl|exact IHqstp].
  - eapply Subq_trans; [exact IHqstp1|exact IHqstp2].
Qed.

Lemma qstp_closed_both_nl : forall Γ (Σ:senv) q d,
  no_lookup Γ -> qstp Γ Σ q d -> qstp Γ Σ d q ->
  closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (Q_lift q) ->
  closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (Q_lift d).
Proof.
  intros Γ Σ q d Hnl Hqs Hrev Hc.
  pose proof (qstp_subq_nl Γ Σ d q Hnl Hrev) as Hsub.
  destruct Hc as [Hf [Hb Hl]]. destruct Hsub as [Hs1 [Hs2 [Hs3 Hs4]]].
  unfold N_sub in Hs2, Hs3, Hs4. unfold closed_Qual. split; [|split].
  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx.
    specialize (Hs2 x Hx). unfold N_lift in Hs2. apply Hf in Hs2. exact Hs2.
  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx.
    specialize (Hs3 x Hx). unfold N_lift in Hs3. apply Hb in Hs3. exact Hs3.
  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx.
    specialize (Hs4 x Hx). unfold N_lift in Hs4. apply Hl in Hs4. exact Hs4.
Qed.

Lemma stp_closed_target_nl : forall Γ (Σ:senv) T1 d1 T2 d2,
  no_lookup Γ -> closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T1 -> stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
  closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T2.
Proof.
  intros Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 Hnl Hc H. induction H; intros Hc.
  - apply cl_TTop.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - eassumption.
  - apply cl_TUnit.
  - inversion Hc; subst. eapply cl_TRef.
    + eapply IHstp1. eassumption.
    + eapply qstp_closed_both_nl; [exact Hnl|exact H1|exact H2|eassumption].
  - eassumption.
  - eapply IHstp2. eapply IHstp1. exact Hc.
Qed.

Lemma stp_closed_target_nil : forall (Σ:senv) T1 d1 T2 d2,
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T1 -> stp nil Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T2.
Proof.
  intros. eapply stp_closed_target_nl.
  - apply no_lookup_nil.
  - exact H.
  - exact H0.
Qed.
EOF

Lemma closed_Qual_of_subq_or_diamond_f : forall b f L (d φ:qual),
  closed_Qual b f L (Q_lift φ) -> d ⊑↑ (qor φ {♦}) ->
  closed_Qual b f L (Q_lift d).
Proof.
  intros b f L d φ [Hpf [Hpb Hpl]] [Hf [H1 [H2 H3]]].
  unfold closed_Qual. split; [|split].
  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx.
    specialize (H1 x Hx). unfold N_lift in H1. unfold qor in H1. simpl in H1.
    unfold n_or in H1. apply orb_true_iff in H1. destruct H1 as [H1|H1].
    + apply Hpf in H1. exact H1.
    + unfold n_empty in H1. discriminate H1.
  - unfold closed_Nats in *. intros x Hx.
    specialize (H2 x Hx). unfold N_lift in H2. unfold qor in H2. simpl in H2.
    unfold n_or in H2. apply orb_true_iff in H2. destruct H2 as [H2|H2].
    + apply Hpb in H2. exact H2.

    unfold n_or in H3. apply orb_true_iff in H3. destruct H3 as [H3|H3].
    + apply Hpl in H3. exact H3.
    + unfold n_empty in H3. discriminate H3.

Require Export Arith.EqNat.

Require Export PeanoNat.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Arith.

Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.

Require Import Coq.Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Lists.List.

Require Import Psatz.

Require Import ZArith.

Require Import Coq.Arith.Compare_dec.

Import ListNotations.

Require Import vars.

Require Import env.

Require Import nats.

Require Import qualifiers.

Require Import boolean.

Require Import lang.

Require Import qenv.

Import QualNotations.

Local Open Scope qualifiers.

Import OpeningNotations.

Local Open Scope opening.

Class splicible_env {p : Type} `{@qenv p}: Type := {

  env_splice : nat -> p -> p;
  env_unsplice : nat -> p -> p;
  env_elmt_fvs : p -> nat -> bool;

}.

Definition splice_tenv_elmt := (fun n (X : (binding * bool * ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (bd, b, T, q) => (bd, b, splice_ty n T, splice_qual n q)
  end).

Definition splice_senv_elmt := (fun n (X : (ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (T, q) => (splice_ty n T, splice_qual n q)
  end).

Definition unsplice_tenv_elmt := (fun n (X : (binding * bool * ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (bd, b, T, q) => (bd, b, unsplice_ty n T, unsplice_qual n q)
  end).

Definition unsplice_senv_elmt := (fun n (X : (ty * qual)) =>
  match X with
  | (T, q) => (unsplice_ty n T, unsplice_qual n q)
  end).

#[export] Instance tenv_splicible : @splicible_env (binding * bool * ty * qual) tenv_qenv := {
  env_splice := splice_tenv_elmt;
  env_unsplice := unsplice_tenv_elmt;
  env_elmt_fvs := fun a n => tfvs (snd (fst a)) n || qfvs (snd a) n;

}.

#[export] Instance senv_splicible : @splicible_env (ty * qual) senv_qenv := {
  env_splice := splice_senv_elmt;
  env_unsplice := unsplice_senv_elmt;
  env_elmt_fvs := fun a n => tfvs (fst a) n || qfvs (snd a) n;

}.

Definition splice_env {p : Type} `{splicible_env p} (n : nat) (E : env p) : env p := map (env_splice n) E.

Definition splice_tenv (n : nat) (Γ : tenv) : tenv := splice_env n Γ.

Definition splice_senvs (n : nat) (Σ : senvs) : senvs := splice_env n Σ.

Definition splice_senv (n : nat) (Σ : senv) : senv := map (splice_senvs n) Σ.

Module SplicingNotations.

Declare Scope splicing.

Notation "t ↑ᵗ n" := (splice n t) (at level 10) : splicing.

Notation "T ↑ᵀ n" := (splice_ty n T) (at level 10) : splicing.

Notation "q ↑ᵈ n" := (splice_qual n q) (at level 10) : splicing.

Notation "g ↑ᴳ n" := (splice_env n g) (at level 10) : splicing.

Notation "g s↑ᴳ n" := (splice_senv n g) (at level 10) : splicing.

End SplicingNotations.

Import SplicingNotations.

Local Open Scope splicing.

Fixpoint subst_tm (t : tm) (v : nat) (u : tm) : tm :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t       => ttabs (subst_tm t v u)
  | ttapp t       => ttapp (subst_tm t v u)
  | tunit         => tunit
  | # x           => # x
  | $ x           => if Nat.eqb x v then u else $(pred x)
  | tabs t        => tabs (subst_tm t v u)
  | tapp t1 t2    => tapp (subst_tm t1 v u) (subst_tm t2 v u)
  | & (l, o)      => & (l, o)
  | tref t        => tref (subst_tm t v u)
  | trefat t1 t2  => trefat (subst_tm t1 v u) (subst_tm t2 v u)
  | ! t           => ! (subst_tm t v u)
  | tassign t1 t2 => tassign (subst_tm t1 v u) (subst_tm t2 v u)
  | twithr t1 t2  => twithr (subst_tm t1 v u) (subst_tm t2 v u)
  | twithc l t    => twithc l (subst_tm t v u)
  end.

Definition openq' {A} (env : list A) q  := openq ($!‖env‖) $!(S (‖env‖)) q.

Fixpoint open_rec_ty (k : nat)(U:  ty) (d' : qual) (T : ty) : ty :=
  match T with
  | TTop              => TTop
  | TVar (varF x)     => TVar (varF x)
  | TVar (varB x)     => if Nat.eqb k x then U else (TVar (varB x))
  | TAll d1 d2 T1 T2  => TAll (open_qual k d' d1) (open_qual (S (S k)) d' d2) (open_rec_ty k U d' T1) (open_rec_ty (S (S k)) U d' T2)
  | TUnit             => TUnit
  | TFun d1 d2 T1 T2  => TFun (open_qual k d' d1) (open_qual (S (S k)) d' d2) (open_rec_ty k U d' T1) (open_rec_ty (S (S k)) U d' T2)
  | TRef d T          => TRef (open_qual k d' d) (open_rec_ty k U d' T)
  end.

Import SplicingNotations.

Local Open Scope splicing.

Import SubstitutionNotations.

Inductive disjointq (Σ Σ' : senv) : qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| disj_bot : forall q,
    disjointq Σ Σ' q ∅
| disj_loc : forall T q q',
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    ♦∉ q ->
    Σ' = [(T,q)] :: Σ ->
    disjointq Σ Σ' q' (&!‖Σ‖)
.

Arguments disj_loc { Σ Σ' }.

Notation " S → T ∋ q ⊕ q'" := (disjointq S T q q') (at level 10).

Definition CtxOK (Γ : tenv) (φ : qual) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (σ : store) : Prop :=
  qdom' σ ⊑↑ qdom Σ /\ ‖ σ ‖ = ‖ Σ ‖ /\
     φ ⊑↑ (qdom Σ) /\
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) ϰ↑ /\
  kill_sep ϰ φ /\
  forall l o cty T q,
  (l ∈ₗ ϰ -> indexr l σ = Some None) /\ (~(l∈ₗ ϰ) ->
    l ∈ₗ φ ->
    indexr l Σ = Some cty ->
    (exists ctm, (indexr l σ = Some (Some ctm) /\ (‖ cty ‖) = (‖ ctm ‖)) /\
    (indexr o cty = Some (T,q) ->  (exists v, indexr o ctm = Some v /\
      value v /\ (q ⊑↑ φ -> vtp Σ ϰ φ v T q))))

  )
.

Fixpoint wf_step (t:tm) : Prop :=
  match t with
  | ttabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | ttapp t1 => wf_step t1
  | tabs t1 => local_locs t1 = ∅
  | tapp t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | tref t1 => wf_step t1
  | trefat t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t1 = ∅ \/ (value t2))
  | tderef t1 => wf_step t1
  | tassign t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ ((value t1) \/ local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithr t1 t2 => wf_step t1 /\ wf_step t2 /\ (local_locs t2 = ∅)
  | twithc l t1 => wf_step t1
  | _ => True
  end.

Definition wf_store (σ : store) : Prop :=
    forall l o v, sindexr' l o σ = Some (v) -> wf_step v /\ value v.

Inductive envUpdate (Σ : senv) (φ : qual) (ϰ : qual) (LC : qual): senv -> qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| env_phi : forall Σ',

    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->
    ‖Σ'‖ = ‖Σ‖ ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ ϰ
| env_fresh : forall T q,
    kill_sep ϰ q ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC ([(T,q)] :: Σ) (φ ⊔ &!(‖Σ‖)) ϰ
| env_kill : forall l,
    l < (‖Σ‖) ->
    l ∈ₗ LC ->
    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ (q_remove Σ l φ) (ϰ ⊔ &!l)
.

Inductive preserve (Γ : tenv) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (φ : qual) (LC : qual) (t' : tm) (T : ty) (d : qual) (σ' : store) : Prop :=
| Preserve : forall Σ' d' φ' ϰ',
    Σ' ⊇₂ Σ ->

    envUpdate Σ φ ϰ LC Σ' φ' ϰ' ->
    d' ⊑↑ φ' ->
    wf_senv Σ' ->
    CtxOK Γ φ' Σ' ϰ' σ' ->
    Σ → Σ' ∋ d ⊕ d'  ->
    has_type Γ φ' Σ' t' T (d ⋓ d') ->

    wf_store σ' ->
    wf_step t' ->
    preserve Γ Σ ϰ φ LC t' T d σ'.

Notation " S → T ∋ q ⊕ q'" := (disjointq S T q q') (at level 10).

Definition CtxOK (Γ : tenv) (φ : qual) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (σ : store) : Prop :=
  qdom' σ ⊑↑ qdom Σ /\ ‖ σ ‖ = ‖ Σ ‖ /\
     φ ⊑↑ (qdom Σ) /\
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) ϰ↑ /\
  kill_sep ϰ φ /\
  forall l o cty T q,
  (l ∈ₗ ϰ -> indexr l σ = Some None) /\ (~(l∈ₗ ϰ) ->
    l ∈ₗ φ ->
    indexr l Σ = Some cty ->
    (exists ctm, (indexr l σ = Some (Some ctm) /\ (‖ cty ‖) = (‖ ctm ‖)) /\
    (indexr o cty = Some (T,q) ->  (exists v, indexr o ctm = Some v /\
      value v /\ (q ⊑↑ φ -> vtp Σ ϰ φ v T q))))

  )
.

  has_type Γ φ Σ v (TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) d -> value v ->

    + exact H0.

    + exact H2.

python3 - <<'PYEOF'
s=open('Task.v').read()
ins='''Lemma qand_fresh : forall a b, qfresh (qand a b) = andb (qfresh a) (qfresh b).
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma qand_fvs : forall a b, qfvs (qand a b) = n_and (qfvs a) (qfvs b).
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma qand_bvs : forall a b, qbvs (qand a b) = n_and (qbvs a) (qbvs b).
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.
Lemma qand_locs : forall a b, qlocs (qand a b) = n_and (qlocs a) (qlocs b).
Proof. intros. reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma qdiff_qand : forall a b c,
  qdiff (qand a b) c = qand (qdiff a c) (qdiff b c).
Proof.
  intros. apply qual_ext.
  - rewrite qdiff_fresh, qand_fresh, qand_fresh, qdiff_fresh, qdiff_fresh.
    destruct (qfresh a); destruct (qfresh b); destruct (qfresh c); reflexivity.
  - apply functional_extensionality. intro x.
    rewrite qdiff_fvs, qand_fvs, qand_fvs, qdiff_fvs, qdiff_fvs.
    unfold n_diff, n_and. simpl.
    destruct (qfvs a x); destruct (qfvs b x); destruct (qfvs c x); reflexivity.
  - apply functional_extensionality. intro x.
    rewrite qdiff_bvs, qand_bvs, qand_bvs, qdiff_bvs, qdiff_bvs.
    unfold n_diff, n_and. simpl.
    destruct (qbvs a x); destruct (qbvs b x); destruct (qbvs c x); reflexivity.
  - apply functional_extensionality. intro x.
    rewrite qdiff_locs, qand_locs, qand_locs, qdiff_locs, qdiff_locs.
    unfold n_diff, n_and. simpl.
    destruct (qlocs a x); destruct (qlocs b x); destruct (qlocs c x); reflexivity.
Qed.

'''
marker="(* ===== End partial proof infrastructure ===== *)"
s=s.replace(marker, ins+marker,1)
open('Task.v','w').write(s)
PYEOF
timeout 900 coqc -R . "" Task.v 2>&1 | grep -B3 -A12 -i error | head -30; echo "Qed=$(grep -c Qed Task.v)"

Inductive value : tm -> Prop :=
| value_ttabs: forall t, value (ttabs t)
| value_abs : forall t, value (tabs t)
| value_cst : value tunit
| value_loc : forall l o, value &(l, o)
.

Definition store := list (option (list (tm))).

Inductive step : tm -> store -> tm -> store -> Prop :=

| step_ttapp: forall t σ,
  step (ttapp (ttabs t)) σ (t <~ᵗ (ttabs t); tunit) σ
| step_beta : forall t v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tapp (tabs t) v) σ (t <~ᵗ (tabs t); v) σ
| step_ref : forall v σ,
    value v ->
    step (tref v) σ (&‖σ‖) ((Some [v]) :: σ)
| step_refat: forall v l o s σ,
    value v ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->

    step (trefat v &(l, o)) σ &(l, ‖s‖) (cinsert σ l (v))
| step_deref : forall σ l o s v,
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    indexr o s = Some (v) ->
    step (! &(l, o)) σ v σ
| step_assign : forall σ l o v s,
    l < ‖σ‖ ->
    indexr l σ = Some (Some s) ->
    o < ‖s‖ ->
    value v ->
    step (tassign &(l, o) v) σ tunit (supdate σ l o v)
| step_twithr : forall σ v t,
    value v ->
    step (twithr v t) σ (twithc (‖σ‖) (t <~ᵗ tunit; (&‖σ‖))) ((Some [v]) :: σ)
| step_twithc : forall σ v l,
    value v ->
    step (twithc l v) σ v (update σ l None)

| step_c_tapp: forall t t' σ σ',
  step t σ t' σ' ->
  step (ttapp t)  σ (ttapp t') σ'
| step_c_ref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step (tref t) σ (tref t') σ'
| step_c_refat_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    value t2 ->
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_refat_r : forall t1 t2 t2' σ σ',
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (trefat t1 t2) σ (trefat t1 t2') σ'
| step_c_deref : forall t t' σ σ',
    step t σ t' σ' ->
    step !t σ !t' σ'
| step_c_app_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tapp t1 t2) σ (tapp t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_app_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tapp v t2) σ (tapp v t2') σ'
| step_c_assign_l : forall t1 t1' t2 σ σ',
    step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
    step (tassign t1 t2) σ (tassign t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_assign_r : forall v t2 t2' σ σ',
    value v ->
    step t2 σ t2' σ' ->
    step (tassign v t2) σ (tassign v t2') σ'
| step_c_twithr_l : forall t1 t2 t1' σ σ',
  step t1 σ t1' σ' ->
  step (twithr t1 t2) σ (twithr t1' t2) σ'
| step_c_twithc : forall l t t' σ σ',
  step t σ t' σ' ->
  step (twithc l t) σ (twithc l t') σ'
.

Definition relation (X : Type)(Y: Type) := X -> Y -> X ->  Y -> Prop.

Definition deterministic {X : Type}{Y: Type} (R : relation X Y) :=
  forall (x x1 x2 : X) (y y1 y2: Y), R x y x1 y1 -> R x y x2 y2 -> x1 = x2 /\ y1 = y2.

Local Open Scope substitutions.

| SExact : forall Γ Σ df,    ♦∉ df -> Substq Γ Σ df df

    closed_Qual 0 (‖ Γ ‖) (‖ Σ ‖) df ↑ ->
    Substq Γ Σ (q_trans_tenv Γ df ⋒ q_trans_tenv Γ dx) dx
.

Inductive disjointq (Σ Σ' : senv) : qual -> qual -> Prop :=
| disj_bot : forall q,
    disjointq Σ Σ' q ∅
| disj_loc : forall T q q',
    closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
    closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q↑ ->
    ♦∉ q ->
    Σ' = [(T,q)] :: Σ ->
    disjointq Σ Σ' q' (&!‖Σ‖)
.

Arguments disj_loc { Σ Σ' }.

Notation " S → T ∋ q ⊕ q'" := (disjointq S T q q') (at level 10).

Definition CtxOK (Γ : tenv) (φ : qual) (Σ : senv) (ϰ : qual) (σ : store) : Prop :=
  qdom' σ ⊑↑ qdom Σ /\ ‖ σ ‖ = ‖ Σ ‖ /\
     φ ⊑↑ (qdom Σ) /\
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) ϰ↑ /\
  kill_sep ϰ φ /\
  forall l o cty T q,
  (l ∈ₗ ϰ -> indexr l σ = Some None) /\ (~(l∈ₗ ϰ) ->
    l ∈ₗ φ ->
    indexr l Σ = Some cty ->

           ++ intros l o cty T' q'. split.
              ** intros Hmem. unfold N_lift in Hmem.
                 pose proof (closed_qual_qlocs_bound 0 0 (‖Σ‖) ϰ Hcl l Hmem) as Hlt.
                 assert (Hlts : l < length σ) by lia.
                 rewrite (indexr_cons_old (Some (v :: nil)) σ l Hlts).
                 exact (proj1 (Hcell l o cty T' q') Hmem).
              ** intros Hnotmem Hphi' Hlook.
                 destruct (Nat.eqb l (length Σ)) eqn:E.

                     assert (Hnew : indexr (length Σ) (((T,q)::nil)::Σ) = Some ((T,q)::nil))

Lemma has_type_weaken_phi : forall Γ φ Σ t T d,
  has_type Γ φ Σ t T d ->
  forall φ', φ ⊑↑ φ' -> closed_Qual 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) (Q_lift φ') ->
  has_type Γ φ' Σ t T d.
Proof.
  intros Γ φ Σ t T d H. induction H; intros φ' Hle Hcl.
  - apply t_tabs; eauto 8. eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift φ); [eassumption|exact Hle].
  - apply t_tapp; eauto 10.
    eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift (φ ⊔ {♦})); [eassumption | apply qor_subq_mono; [exact Hle | apply Subq_refl]].
    eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift φ); [eassumption|exact Hle].
  - apply t_tapp_fresh; eauto 10.
    eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift (φ ⊔ {♦})); [eassumption | apply qor_subq_mono; [exact Hle | apply Subq_refl]].
    eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift (φ ⊔ {♦})); [eassumption | apply qor_subq_mono; [exact Hle | apply Subq_refl]].
    eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift (φ ⊔ {♦})); [eassumption | apply qor_subq_mono; [exact Hle | apply Subq_refl]].
  - apply t_base; eauto 8.
  - eapply t_var; eauto 10. eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift φ); [eassumption|exact Hle].
  - eapply t_abs; eauto 8. eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift φ); [eassumption|exact Hle].
  - eapply t_app with (φd := qdiff φ' (local_locs t1)); eauto 12.
    all: try solve_qdiff_ih IHhas_type2.
    all: try (eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift (φ ⊔ {♦})); [eassumption | apply qor_subq_mono; [exact Hle | apply Subq_refl]]).
  - eapply t_app_fresh with (φd := qdiff φ' (local_locs t1)); eauto 12.
    all: try solve_qdiff_ih IHhas_type2.
    all: try (eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift (φ ⊔ {♦})); [eassumption | apply qor_subq_mono; [exact Hle | apply Subq_refl]]).
  - apply t_loc; eauto 10. eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift φ); [eassumption|exact Hle].
  - apply t_ref; eauto 8.
  - eapply t_refat with (φd := qdiff φ' (local_locs t2)); eauto 12.
    all: try solve_qdiff_ih IHhas_type1.
  - eapply t_deref; eauto 10. eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift φ); [eassumption|exact Hle].
  - eapply t_assign with (φd := qdiff φ' (local_locs t1)); eauto 12.
    all: try solve_qdiff_ih IHhas_type2.
  - eapply t_sub; eauto 10. eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift (φ ⊔ {♦})); [eassumption | apply qor_subq_mono; [exact Hle | apply Subq_refl]].
  - eapply t_withr; eauto 10. eapply Subq_trans with (b := Q_lift φ); [eassumption|exact Hle].
  - apply t_withc; eauto 10.
Qed.

  - eapply t_abs; eauto using closed_ty_loc_weaken, closed_Qual_loc_weaken, closed_tm_loc_weaken.

Import SubstitutionNotations.

Inductive vtp: senv -> qual -> qual -> tm -> ty -> qual -> Prop :=
| vtp_tabs: forall Σ ϰ φ t T1 T2 T3 T4 d1 d2 d3 d4 df1 df2,
  closed_tm 2 0 (‖Σ‖) t ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) (TAll d3 d4 T3 T4) ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
  has_type [(bind_ty, false, T1, d1); (bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), df1)] (df1 ⊔ $!0 ⊔ $!1) Σ
           (t <~²ᵗ ([] : tenv)) (T2 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d2 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv)) ->
  stp [] Σ T3 d3 T1 d1 ->
  qstp [] Σ df1 df2 ->
  stp [(bind_ty, false, T3, d3); (bind_tm, true, (TAll d1 d2 T1 T2), {♦})] Σ
      (T2 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d2 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv))
      (T4 <~²ᵀ ([] : tenv)) (d4 <~²ᵈ ([] : tenv)) ->
  d1 ⊑↑ df1 ⊔ {♦} ->
  ♦∉ df1 ->
  kill_sep ϰ df2 ->
  kill_sep (local_locs t) df2 ->
  vtp Σ ϰ φ (ttabs t) (TAll d3 d4 T3 T4) df2

| vtp_base: forall Σ ϰ φ d,
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
  kill_sep ϰ d ->
  vtp Σ ϰ φ tunit TUnit d

| vtp_loc:  forall Σ ϰ φ l o T U q1 q2 d,
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) d↑ ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) T ->
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q1↑ ->
  closed_Qual 0 0 (‖Σ‖) q2↑ ->

Lemma stp_closed_target_nl : forall Γ (Σ:senv) T1 d1 T2 d2,
  no_lookup Γ -> closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T1 -> stp Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 ->
  closed_ty 0 (‖Γ‖) (‖Σ‖) T2.
Proof.
  intros Γ Σ T1 d1 T2 d2 Hnl Hc H. revert Hc. induction H; intros Hc.
  - apply cl_TTop.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - exfalso. eapply Hnl; eauto.
  - eassumption.
  - apply cl_TUnit.
  - inversion Hc; subst. eapply cl_TRef.
    + eapply IHstp1; [exact Hnl|exact H9].

  - eassumption.
  - eapply IHstp2; [exact Hnl|]. eapply IHstp1; [exact Hnl|exact Hc].

  d' ⊑↑ d ->

  qstp (P ++ (bind_tm,false,U',d') :: D) Σ q1 q2.
Proof.
  intros Σ Γ q1 q2 H. induction H; intros P D UB d UB' d' HcUB' Hcd' Hcd Hsub Hnd E.
  - (* qs_sq *) eapply qs_sq; [exact H|]. rewrite E in H0. exact H0.

    + rewrite E in H. rewrite indexr_prefix_other in H.
      * exact H.

    + apply Nat.eqb_neq in Ex.

    + apply IHqstp2; [exact HcUB'|exact Hcd'|exact Hcd|exact Hsub|exact Hnd|exact E].
Qed.

Lemma qstp_ctx_fun_repl : forall (Σ:senv) (Γ:tenv) q1 q2,
  qstp Γ Σ q1 q2 ->
  forall P D UB UB' d,
  (exists d1 d2 T1 T2, UB = TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
  (exists d1 d2 T1 T2, UB' = TFun d1 d2 T1 T2) ->
  closed_ty 0 0 (‖Σ‖) UB' ->
  Γ = P ++ (bind_tm,true,UB,d) :: D ->
  qstp (P ++ (bind_tm,true,UB',d) :: D) Σ q1 q2.
Proof.
  intros Σ Γ q1 q2 H. induction H; intros P D UB UB' d HUB HUB' HcUB' E;
    rewrite E in *; pose proof (ctx_len_fun_repl P D UB UB' d) as Hlen; try rewrite Hlen in *.
  - (* qs_sq *) eapply qs_sq; eassumption.
  - (* qs_self *) destruct (Nat.eqb f (length D)) eqn:Ex.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in Ex. subst f.
      rewrite indexr_prefix_head in H. inversion H; subst.
      destruct HUB' as (a' & b' & c' & e' & EU'). subst UB'.
      eapply qs_self.
      * rewrite indexr_prefix_head. reflexivity.
      * exact H0.
      * exact H1.
    + apply Nat.eqb_neq in Ex.
      eapply qs_self.
      * rewrite <- (indexr_prefix_other P D (bind_tm,true,UB,d) (bind_tm,true,UB',d) f); [exact H|exact Ex].
      * exact H0.
      * exact H1.
  - (* qs_self_all *) destruct (Nat.eqb f (length D)) eqn:Ex.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in Ex. subst f.
      rewrite indexr_prefix_head in H. inversion H; subst.
      destruct HUB as (a & b & c & e & EU). discriminate EU.
    + apply Nat.eqb_neq in Ex.
      eapply qs_self_all.
      * rewrite <- (indexr_prefix_other P D (bind_tm,true,UB,d) (bind_tm,true,UB',d) f); [exact H|exact Ex].
      * exact H0.
      * exact H1.
  - (* qs_qvar *) destruct (Nat.eqb x (length D)) eqn:Ex.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in Ex. subst x.
      rewrite indexr_prefix_head in H. inversion H; subst.
      eapply qs_qvar.
      * rewrite indexr_prefix_head. reflexivity.
      * eapply closed_ty_weaken; [exact HcUB'|lia|lia].
      * exact H1.
      * exact H2.
    + apply Nat.eqb_neq in Ex.
      eapply qs_qvar.
      * rewrite <- (indexr_prefix_other P D (bind_tm,true,UB,d) (bind_tm,true,UB',d) x); [exact H|exact Ex].
      * exact H0.
      * exact H1.
      * exact H2.
  - (* qs_qvar_ty *) destruct (Nat.eqb x (length D)) eqn:Ex.
    + apply Nat.eqb_eq in Ex. subst x.
      rewrite indexr_prefix_head in H. inversion H.
    + apply Nat.eqb_neq in Ex.
      eapply qs_qvar_ty.
      * rewrite <- (indexr_prefix_other P D (bind_tm,true,UB,d) (bind_tm,true,UB',d) x); [exact H|exact Ex].
      * exact H0.
      * exact H1.
      * exact H2.
  - (* qs_cong *) eapply qs_cong.
    + apply (IHqstp P D UB UB' d HUB HUB' HcUB' eq_refl).
    + exact H0.
  - (* qs_trans *) eapply qs_trans.
    + apply (IHqstp1 P D UB UB' d HUB HUB' HcUB' eq_refl).
    + apply (IHqstp2 P D UB UB' d HUB HUB' HcUB' eq_refl).
Qed.
